description: It traces what one participant goes through in a webinar, in order and without sending anything: which confirmation and reminder mails go out at which moment and which are switched off, when the room opens, when the offer appears and when the replay shows. Take it when a host asks what participants get and when. "Do they get a reminder the day before?" It is the cheapest way to check the timing before a launch. It needs the webinar id and only reads. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: participant journey, reminder timing, room opens, offer appears

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.
